title: Chapter 7046: Ultimate Particle

Chapter 7046: Ultimate Particle

Chapter 7046: Ultimate Particle

“This is not a threat, just a warning.” Heaven’s Equal shook his head.

“We say the same to you, for it is not easy to reach your current cultivation.” Immortal Bronze said.

“I don’t understand your confidence.” He said.

“You don’t know our ace cards, so I advise you to worry about yourself. It is not too late to join us, otherwise...” Immortal Bronze warned.

“Ace cards?” Immortals exchanged glances.

“Only a celestial immortal can challenge Li Qiye.” A golden immortal said.

“It has to be insane, but I can’t imagine anything capable of this.” A different immortal said.

Everyone saw Li Qiye’s power and how his gaze alone killed golden immortals. Primordial immortals weren’t qualified to face him, only celestial immortals with apex power.

Thus, they didn’t understand Immortal Bronze’s confidence.

“Lord of Fortress is coming?” An immortal said.

“Still not strong enough, haven’t reached the shore to become a celestial immortal.” Someone disagreed.

As others discussed the matter, Heaven’s Equal said: “I appreciate your concern, but don’t wait too long before changing your mind.”

“It appears we both feel the same way. You'd best leave now or...” Immortal Bronze said.

“Or what?” Heaven’s Equal’s expression darkened. He was stronger than either one and didn’t mind an actual fight.

“Or we’ll send you to the other side. Try this Particle Spit!” Ash-serpent released a particle made from his grand dao.

It contained immense pressure and temperature despite its small form. Its destructive potential could wipe out karma and the reincarnation cycles.

“Not good!” The slightest trace of the particle drifted like mist and melted time itself.

When they touched immortals, they didn’t spare even the golden ones. They screamed in agony as their bodies corroded. Nonetheless, they retreated and leaped into different dimensions to observe from afar.

“Beyond Heaven’s Will.” Heaven’s Equal chanted and conjured a sharp primordial intent.

It cut through the particle and aimed for Ash-serpent, proving his superiority despite being in the same stage. Of course, he wouldn’t be able to kill either opponent in a short time.

The first move alone caused instability in time within Dusk Realm. Eras were twisted chaotically.

“Try this, Immortal Monarch.” Immortal Bronze didn’t resort to a sneak attack and stated his intention before aiming his weapon.

“Heaven Caparace, Eternal Bulwark!” Heaven’s Equal was startled and summoned firmaments around him, forming armor plates and a frontal bulwark.

“Break!” Immortal Bronze fired.
